title: Jesus Christ in the Temple
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells Jesus in the temple at twelve (Luke 2:42-49) and says he went home and obeyed his parents.

floor.prerequisite: Knows a church is a place of worship.
floor.question: What do people do in church?

steps: Arrange the event cards in order.
contexts: a child who wanders off at the market

board.do: Wait for the child to say listening and asking questions.
Write: he went home and obeyed.

misconceptions.ask: How old was Jesus when he stayed in the temple?
misconceptions.repair: Show a picture of a boy of twelve.

misconceptions.ask: Where did his parents find Jesus?
What was Jesus doing in the temple?
misconceptions.repair: Act it out: sit, listen, ask.

misconceptions.ask: What did Jesus do after his parents found him?

checks.question: Where did his parents find him?
